parsedVerdict.reasoning: This module passes. All four files belong to one concern, the Express HTTP adapter: route controllers, request-shape parsing and error-to-response mapping. Each rule lives in one place. JSON-shape checks are only in requestParsing.ts, and the code there says business validation stays in the domain. The HTTP status for each error kind is only in errorMiddleware.ts. The controllers rely on these shared pieces instead of writing their own: OrderController parses with parsePlaceOrderBody, parseStatusBody and requireString, and leaves error handling to errorMiddleware. The message 'Request body must be a JSON object' appears twice, but both copies are in requestParsing.ts and both use the isRecord helper, so the rule isn't spread across files. StockController doesn't read anything from the request, so it doesn't need requestParsing.
